title: Phonk Velocity
description: High-energy velocity edit: speed ramps that snap into slow motion on the beat, strobing black-and-white inserts, heavy shake on the bass and chromatic splits.

example.credit: Example made with open-katana: a fictional person (generated with Z-Image Turbo) on an original ACE-Step 1.5 XL track.

optionPrompts.Me: Hero: the person in the photos.
optionPrompts.My car: Hero: the person's car from the photos; the person appears beside it.
optionPrompts.My bike: Hero: the person on their bike from the photos.

brief.label: The red word at the drop

recipe.look: high contrast, desaturated with alternating black-and-white and inverted 2–4 frame inserts, RGB split on hits
recipe.energy: 2–4 cuts per second; every clip ramps from fast (2×) to slow (0.3×) landing on a beat; shake bursts on every kick; strobe during the build.

structure.guidance: Hard cut in on a fast move, ramp into slow motion on beat 2.
Alternating colour and black-and-white inserts, strobe, accelerating cut rate.
Freeze frame + red accent word slam.
Velocity ramps on every bar; last shot holds on the hero, hard cut to black.

recipe.titles: Single red accent word in Archivo Black at the drop; small monospaced captions in corners.
recipe.music: Drift phonk with a heavy cowbell line; cut on kicks and cowbell hits.
recipe.generation: Generate 3–4 s clips with strong single actions (turn, walk, jacket flick) so ramps have motion to slow down; I2V at 16 fps then blend-interpolate in the edit.

prompt: @image1 is the hero. Every shot is a decisive motion that can be ramped: turning, stepping forward, pulling a jacket on.
author: open-katana
